predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not a verified exact reconstruction. Inspection advertised catalogue quantities 10, 50, 200 and 1000. Their observed prices were respectively 108616, 108616, 114163 and 409189 cents, with roundingCents=0; the alternate workflow in session 2 returned identical values. All tested non-catalogue estimate/alias requests and all tested approved requests were denied. The predictor assumes a minimum charge of 108616 cents and an affine price fitted to quantities 200 and 1000. It reproduces all observed prices exactly. The transition at 185 is inferred, not observed; nonlinear behaviour, other bands and different prices at unobserved quantities remain possible. Used 21 business requests and 6 REA operations.
